data.body:
Gerrit -1 round addressed; re-pushed both patchsets (Change-Ids preserved).

Change 2457 (Phase 1) -> PS2 ba9e093b9c7c:
- BLOCKING (Verified-1, docs drift): regenerated docs/mcp-reference.md on the Phase-1 tree. Took Option (a): STRIPPED the *_start steering from the sync review_plan/verify_completion docstrings so Phase 1 no longer references tools that don't exist until Phase 2; mcp-reference now matches Phase-1 code (gen --check clean, 0 *_start refs).
- BLOCKING (LLM-Review-1, coverage): test_mcp_llm_dedup.py now parametrizes BOTH review_plan AND verify_completion (distinct variant key) through the tool-level singleflight. Also made the proof deterministic: release the leader only once a REAL follower attaches (spy on _await_follower) with a bounded fallback, since the first CallTool's cold pydantic warm-up blocks the loop and made the fixed-sleep window racy. Teeth: with REBAR_MCP_DEDUP=0 the test fails cleanly (calls==2) in ~6s, no hang.
- Advisories: tightened the _mcp_inflight max-age comment (no longer over-claims 'nothing blocked forever'); steering ordering fixed by Option (a).

Change 2459 (Phase 2) -> PS2 9b528c36c18b:
- BLOCKING (LLM-Review-1, correctness): verify_completion_status now reads the LIST-shaped manifest via _authoritative_manifest/_authoritative_head (mirroring plan_review_status) instead of the dead isinstance(manifest, dict) guard, so verified_at_sha is populated. Added two tests (pinned verified-at-sha step; fallback to signed head). Teeth verified: both fail with the old dead branch.
- Advisories fixed: (1) follower *_start (is_new=False) no longer re-records a 'running' handle -> can't clobber a leader's terminal record; (2) the async *_start bodies now offload _start_gate_job (basis-SHA git shell-out + index write) via anyio.to_thread so they don't block the event loop; (3) added _terminal_from_result branch tests (error->failed, PASS/BLOCK->passed) and a daemon-exception->failed test.

make lint + make typecheck green on BOTH trees; output-schema coverage green. Not submitting/closing (orchestrator's step once votes go green).
